units.source_text: “像那棵枫树多顽强啊，可在我身上……”

en.t: “That maple tree is so tenacious, but in me...”

units.source_text: 千重子的话声里带着哀伤的情调，

en.t: There was a sorrowful tone in Chieko's voice,

units.source_text: “我顶多就像生长在枫树干小洞里的紫花地丁。

en.t: “At most, I am like a violet growing in a little hollow in the trunk of a maple tree.

units.source_text: 哎呀，紫花地丁的花，不知不觉间也凋谢了。”

en.t: Ah, before I knew it, the violet's flowers had withered too.”
